Author: Kotanna
Name: Job Profiles
Punchline: Switch HUD layout and run macros when you change job.
Description: Pick a HUD layout and/or macros for each role (tanks, healers, melee, crafters…), and override them for single jobs. Whenever your job changes, however you change it, the layout is applied and the macros run in order. /jobprofiles opens settings; /jobprofiles apply re-applies the current job's profile.
